# TextDescriptor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Describes rich text content with multiple spans. Provides methods for adding styled text spans, page numbers, and total page counts. Maps to a `RichText` element internally.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new TextDescriptor()
```

## Methods

- [`Align`](#align): Sets the paragraph alignment for the whole text block (Left, Center, Right, or Justify).
- [`AlignCenter`](#aligncenter): Centers the paragraph.
- [`AlignLeft`](#alignleft): Aligns the paragraph to the left (default).
- [`AlignRight`](#alignright): Aligns the paragraph to the right.
- [`CurrentPageNumber`](#currentpagenumber): Inserts the current page number.
- [`Justify`](#justify): Justifies the paragraph (flush on both edges, except the last line).
- [`Line`](#line): Adds a text span followed by a line break.
- [`LineBreak`](#linebreak): Adds a line break.
- [`Span`](#span): Adds a text span with optional styling.
- [`TotalPages`](#totalpages): Inserts the total page count.
